subject: general
question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.

Someone working or acting merely for money or other rewards
solution: The correct answer is - Mercenary. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** • A "**mercenary**" is** a person who is hired to work or act for money or other rewards. (**वह व्यक्ति जिसे पैसे या अन्य पुरस्कारों के लिए काम करने या कार्य करने के लिए नियुक्त किया जाता है) • They are motivated by financial gain rather than by principles or loyalty. • A "**Debtor**" is a person who owes money to others. ( कर्जदार) • A "**Contractor**" is a person or company who is hired to perform work or provide services to another party. (ठेकेदार) • A "**Player"** is **a person who participates in a game or a sport. (**खिलाड़ी) • Therefore, out of the given options, the most appropriate one-word substitute is "Mercenary." 4c:T452, Correct answer - 3) Born
